mapper.select: SELECT et.type_id AS type_id, et.type_name AS type_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM equipment_assets ea WHERE ea.type_id = et.type_id) AS total_equipment, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM equipment_assets ea WHERE ea.type_id = et.type_id AND ea.offline_status = '1') AS online_equipment, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM monitor_point_alert mpa INNER JOIN equipment_assets a2 ON mpa.equipment_id = a2.asset_id WHERE a2.type_id = et.type_id) AS alert_count FROM equipment_type et WHERE et.type_id IN (145, 115, 147, 148) ORDER BY et.sort ASC
SELECT content, COUNT(*) AS numb FROM monitor_point_alert GROUP BY content ORDER BY numb DESC

SELECT s.id, s.monitor_point_id, s.location_id, s.equipment_id, s.trigger_type, s.operation_type, s.operation_reason, s.operation_time, emp.point_name, ea.asset_name, loc.location_name AS asset_location FROM spray_system s LEFT JOIN equipment_monitor_point emp ON s.monitor_point_id = emp.id LEFT JOIN equipment_assets ea ON s.equipment_id = ea.asset_id LEFT JOIN equipment_location loc ON s.location_id = loc.location_id ORDER BY s.operation_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT mp_alert.id, mp_alert.monitor_point_id, mp_alert.equipment_id, mp_alert.monitor_data, mp_alert.content, mp_alert.monitor_log, mp_alert.alert_type, mp_alert.monitor_alert_type, mp_alert.handle_time, mp_alert.recovery_data, mp_alert.recovery_time, mp_alert.handle_by, mp_alert.handle_state, mp_alert.handle_measures, mp_alert.handle_conclu, mp_alert.batch_id, mp_alert.create_time, mp_alert.update_time, eq_assets.asset_name, eq_assets.asset_code, loc.location_name, mp_point.point_name, mp_point.monitor_type, mp_point.monitor_son_type, mp_point.alarm_upper, mp_point.alarm_lower, mp_point.warn_upper, mp_point.warn_lower, mp_point.unit FROM monitor_point_alert mp_alert LEFT JOIN equipment_assets eq_assets ON mp_alert.equipment_id = eq_assets.asset_id LEFT JOIN equipment_monitor_point mp_point ON mp_alert.monitor_point_id = mp_point.id LEFT JOIN equipment_location loc ON eq_assets.location_id = loc.location_id WHERE mp_alert.monitor_alert_type != '4' ORDER BY mp_alert.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
